hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Generate all unique fibonacci numbers strictly less than or equal to n.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Using two or three pointers, search for a triplet (a, b, c) from the generated fibonacci values summing to n.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Return True if any valid triplet combination equals n, otherwise False.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Fibonacci numbers up to 10^9 total only around 45 elements; 3-sum search is constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: General integer partitions blow up exponentially.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Precomputes fibonacci sequence and applies two-pointer three-sum search.
